interface.title: HEEH-V1™ DICOM Viewer
interface.field: Medical imaging research (CT radiology, quantitative imaging / radiomics)
interface.stage_of_work: Image inspection, quantitative measurement and analysis, then de-identified export of results
interface.what_it_is_for: Load DICOM or other medical images, view them with CT windowing kept separate from the raw values, take calibrated distance and angle measurements, compute HU, quality and radiomics metrics, and export de-identified DICOM, DICOM SR, CSV/XLSX and HTML research outputs.

data.note: ct-slice.dcm was uploaded through Direct Upload: CT, MONOCHROME2, 128×128, 0.661468 mm spacing, no window in the file. Later the same file was added a second time to get two images, which turned on the navigation slider and the side-by-side comparison. Both copies are the same image, so comparing them shows no difference and tests matched display only trivially.

tree.general: Take calibrated, reproducible quantitative measurements from a medical image and export them in shareable, de-identified formats
tree.specific: Load a CT DICOM slice, check HU rescaling, window it, compare images, measure distance and angle, run tissue, quality and radiomics analyses and export DICOM, SR, CSV/XLSX and HTML

features.name: Calibrated click-to-measure overlay
features.general: Pick a measurement type, click points on an image and get physical distances or angles from the image's pixel spacing, with a labelled, undoable list of results
features.specific: Measurements panel: Mode Off/Distance (mm)/Angle (deg), Unit mm/cm/px, Decimals, Label for next measurement, then click 2 or 3 points on the Primary image viewer. Each result goes to a list with Delete, Undo last and Clear all, plus a line intensity profile for distances
steps: Click 2 points (distance) or 3 points (angle) on the image
Read the value on the overlay and in the list (e.g. 74.84 mm, 47.73 deg, canal width 15.21 mm)
Undo, delete or clear as needed
serves_tasks: Measure a physical distance between two points
Measure an angle between two arms
Label a measurement and confirm where its calibration comes from

features.name: Spatial calibration source with manual override
features.general: Show where the pixel-size calibration comes from and allow a manual override
features.specific: The Calibration line shows 0.6615 mm/row × 0.6615 mm/column (dicom). The Calibration accuracy expander explains DICOM PixelSpacing use and has a Manual calibration (mm/pixel) toggle
steps: Read the Calibration line under Mode
serves_tasks: Label a measurement and confirm where its calibration comes from

features.name: Display-only windowing with presets and zoom
features.general: Change contrast and magnification for viewing only, while measurements still use the raw values
features.specific: Display Settings: Viewer mode 1:1/2x/4x, Display Window Preset (custom, lung, bone, brain, soft_tissue, vascular_cta, venography, neurovascular…), Window Center/Width sliders (HU) and an 'Effective display window' readout
steps: Pick a window preset or drag Center/Width sliders
Check the viewer and the effective-window text
serves_tasks: Adjust display contrast and magnification without changing the data

features.name: Hover pixel value probe
features.general: Hover over an image to read the calibrated value and coordinates of a single pixel
features.specific: The overlay box on the Primary image viewer shows 'HU: 43.00 · Pixel: (58, 51)'; in a measurement mode it shows the measure point in pixel and mm coordinates
steps: Move the pointer over the image
Read the value and coordinates in the corner box
serves_tasks: Check that stored values are converted to physical units

features.name: Image stack navigator
features.general: Step through a set of loaded images with buttons or a slider
features.specific: Navigation card: Image N of M, Previous/Next buttons (disabled at the ends) and an Image index slider
steps: Press Next/Previous or drag the Image index slider
The viewer and all analyses update for the selected image
serves_tasks: Move between images in a set
Add a second image to the session

features.name: Tabbed quantitative results panel
features.general: One results panel with tabs for intensity statistics, quality proxies, texture features, volume rendering and modality-specific metrics, each turned on from the analysis toggles
features.specific: Analysis results tabs Intensity / Quality / Radiomics / Volume / CT Metrics, driven by the Image Analysis checkboxes (Tissue-Composition Map, Image Quality Proxies, Radiomics-Style Features, Volumetric Visualization)
steps: Tick the analyses wanted in Image Analysis
Read the metric cards and the method notes
serves_tasks: Classify tissue types from intensity thresholds
Estimate image noise and contrast quality

features.name: Threshold-based tissue class map
features.general: Show a map that assigns each pixel to a tissue class by intensity thresholds, with the share of each class
features.specific: Bone/Muscle/Fat Map toggle shows 'Bone / Muscle / Fat — CT intensity classification' under Series browser, comparison & visualizations, with Fat 21.2% · Muscle 17.2% · Bone 11.3%
steps: Read the class map and the class percentages
serves_tasks: Classify tissue types from intensity thresholds

features.name: Edge-filtered image view
features.general: Show an edge-filtered copy of the image to bring out boundaries
features.specific: Edge Detection dropdown (Off/Sobel/Canny/Gradient Mag) shows 'Edge Detection — Canny' under Series browser, comparison & visualizations

features.name: Side-by-side comparison at matched display
features.general: Pick a second image or series and see it next to the current one at the same slice and contrast
features.specific: Compare side-by-side dropdown (None or a listed series) gives two panels with the note 'Same slice index 1, same display window (center 400, width 2000)'. Seen only with two copies of the same file, so matched display is tested only trivially
steps: Pick a series in Compare side-by-side
serves_tasks: View two images next to each other under matched display

features.name: Multi-format export dialog with provenance manifest
features.general: Choose output formats, download each one or all as an archive, with a manifest listing file hashes, methods and privacy limits; formats appear depending on whether measurements exist
features.specific: Export dialog with checkboxes (Anonymized DICOM, Cohort metrics CSV, Radiomics CSV/Excel, Research report HTML, plus DICOM SR, annotated PNG, All measured images ZIP and measurement CSV/JSON when measurements exist), Download buttons, Download all (ZIP) and Export provenance manifest (JSON with sha256, analysis_parameters, privacy, validation_required)
steps: Press a Download button or Download all (ZIP)
Read the provenance manifest to check contents
serves_tasks: Export analysis results, a de-identified image and a provenance manifest
Export measurement records in structured formats

screens_never_reached: User-drawn ROI circle: the interface has none. The header says 'Click the image to inspect an ROI', but clicking with Mode Off only gave the HU readout (screens/017.webp); per the reviewer's reading of the source, the click silently takes stats from a fixed 64 px central region (app.py:8103) and keeps them only for export (app.py:8160-8167). The HTML report contains that default ROI (radius 64 px, mean −112.87 HU, SD 404.66, CV 178.98%). A plan goal 'Draw a calibrated ROI circle' does not match the current interface.
Volume tab rendering (MIP/MPR/3D): the tab showed 'could not be rendered', because the input is a single 2D slice (screens/035.webp).

Longitudinal difference map / difference metrics: not offered by the interface at all; per the reviewer, app.py:74 only imports LongitudinalAnalyzer for compatibility. Only the side-by-side view exists.
MONAI Preprocessing output: the box was ticked (screens/040.webp) but no visible result was found.
Local Directory input mode: not tried, because the browser has no access to server folders.
not_done: Running scripts/validate_export.py on the export ZIP: there is no shell, only a browser.
IBSI Configuration D radiomics with a 3D ROI mask: the 'IBSI ROI mask (NIfTI/RTSTRUCT)' upload is visible in the sidebar (screens/053.webp), but no mask file was available among the test files.

SimpleITK Registration, Model Attention Map (XAI) and Volumetric Visualization modes: not tried, for lack of actions and 3D data. AI (ViT) inference reports 'Model domain brain not validated for CT', so it is disabled.

Possible interface defect: changing Unit to cm left the already listed measurement at '15.21 mm' (screens/059.webp, screens/060.webp); the unit setting may apply only to new measurements or may not work. Not investigated further.
Radiomics Excel and Measurement data JSON downloads, and the contents of the DICOM SR and anonymized DICOM: downloaded or listed, but the binary content was not checked.
